description: Click a point on the page by its position in the latest screenshot, for things the outline can't name: canvas apps (design tools, spreadsheet grids, maps, games), custom-drawn controls, a spot inside a chart. Take a screenshot with max_side=1280 first; x and y are pixels in that image. With to_x and to_y it presses at x, y, drags there and releases. Use click with a ref whenever the element is in the outline. Like click, a point on a button that buys, sends or deletes waits for the user to allow it.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

to_x.description: Drag to this x instead of clicking.

name: click_at
title: Click at a point
